The 31st Forqué Awards ceremony, presented by  took place at the IFEMA Palacio Municipal in Madrid on 13 December 2025. The gala was hosted by Cayetana Guillén Cuervo and Daniel Guzmán.
Background
The nominations were announced on 5 November 2025. Later in the month, producer  was announced as the recipient of the EGEDA Gold Medal. La 2 and RTVE Play will broadcast the ceremony. The musical performances included "" by Ruth Lorenzo, "Nada de nada" by Amaral and Mafalda Cardenal, "" by Chanel and , "Porque te vas" by Jeanette and , "" by  and Cayetana Guillén Cuervo and "" by Shaila Dúrcal.
